title: French Toast with Honeyed Syrup
description: A simple breakfast recipe featuring crispy French toast topped with a sweet honeyed syrup.

ingredients.name: Honeyed syrup
ingredients.notes: See below for honeyed syrup recipe

instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Cook the bread slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Prepare the honeyed syrup by mixing 1/4 cup honey with 1 Tbsp water in a small saucepan.
Heat the honey mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and warm.
Serve the French toast with the honeyed syrup spooned over the top.
Optional: Sprinkle with kinako powder for added crunch and flavor.
